request.story_prompt:
Maya is a young girl who enters a mysterious forest alone. Deep inside the forest, she discovers an old Game Machine near a huge tree.
Curious, Maya touches the machine.
Suddenly—
“GAME START!” 🎮
The forest gates close, and Maya becomes trapped inside the game.
🔴 Level 1 – Forest Run
Maya must run through the dark forest while a terrifying shadow chases her. She avoids dangerous obstacles and successfully completes Level 1.
🟠 Level 2 – Mystery House
Maya enters an abandoned house filled with mysterious puzzles. She must solve the puzzles and find the correct exit before the game resets.
Using her intelligence, Maya completes Level 2.
🟢 Level 3 – Final Choice
Maya reaches the final room. On a table, she finds two cards:
1️⃣ LOSE
2️⃣ WIN
A mysterious voice says:
“Choose only one card…”
Maya takes a deep breath and chooses the WIN card.
Suddenly—
💥 GAME COMPLETED! 💥
The door opens, and Maya escapes from the forest.
Outside, she discovers the game's grand prize: bags of money, gold, and treasure. 💰💎

panels.title: The Forbidden Discovery
panels.scene_description: Maya, a young girl with a backpack, stands in a dark, overgrown forest. She has just found an ancient, glowing arcade machine embedded in the roots of a massive, twisted tree.
panels.image_prompt: Comic book art style, a young girl named Maya with brown hair and a blue jacket standing in a dark forest, she is looking at an old vintage arcade game machine embedded in a giant tree, glowing neon lights, suspenseful atmosphere, dramatic shadows, vibrant colors.

panels.title: Trapped in the Game
panels.scene_description: As Maya touches the screen, the words 'GAME START!' flash in bright pixels. Behind her, the forest path vanishes behind a digital wall of code, trapping her inside.
panels.image_prompt: Comic book style, close up of Maya's hand touching the glowing arcade screen, text bubble saying 'GAME START!', digital glitch effects appearing on the edges of the forest, dark atmosphere, intense lighting.

panels.title: Level 1: The Shadow Chase
panels.scene_description: Maya is sprinting through a dark, foggy forest path, looking back in terror at a towering, amorphous shadow creature stalking her. She jumps over a fallen log.
panels.image_prompt: Action shot, comic book style, Maya running fast through a dark forest, a terrifying dark shadow monster with glowing eyes looming behind her, dynamic perspective, motion lines, high tension.

panels.title: Level 2: The Mystery House
panels.scene_description: Maya stands inside a dusty, abandoned house. She is intensely focused on a complex mechanical puzzle box on a table, the walls of the room are beginning to dissolve into digital pixels.
panels.image_prompt: Comic book style, Maya in a dimly lit Victorian room, she is solving a complex glowing puzzle box, the room is glitching and turning into digital code, suspenseful, detailed textures.

panels.title: The Final Choice and Reward
panels.scene_description: Maya holds the 'WIN' card in her hand. The forest clears, the arcade machine is gone, and she stands in a clearing surrounded by overflowing chests of gold and treasure.
panels.image_prompt: Comic book style, wide shot, Maya standing in a sunny forest clearing, she is holding a glowing card that says 'WIN', piles of gold coins and treasure chests surrounding her, triumphant but mysterious ending, vibrant colors.
